question: In a certain code language, if BRINJAL is coded as ZPKLHCJ, TOMATO is coded as RQKCRQ, then what will STRAWBERRY be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa05794c535d8e3847a5c4e36c56250adadd16270c20615e138f6b6d410bf57.png] 

The logic followed here is:** Each vowel + 2; and Each consonants - 2.**

BRINJAL is coded as ZPKLHCJ,
